registers.name: SYS_ID
registers.description: Device identifier

registers.name: SYS_REV
registers.description: Interface revision

registers.name: IRQ_GLOBAL
registers.description: bit 0 global enable

registers.name: IRQ_ENABLE
registers.description: bits 0..4 source enables

registers.name: IRQ_FLAGS
registers.description: TIMER0, TIMER1, TACH, VBLANK, ADC complete

registers.name: GPIOA_DIR
registers.description: 1 output, 0 input

registers.name: GPIOA_OUT
registers.description: Output latch

registers.name: GPIOA_IN
registers.description: Resolved pad values; wiring determines reset read

registers.name: GPIOB_DIR
registers.description: 1 output, 0 input

registers.name: GPIOB_OUT
registers.description: Output latch

registers.name: GPIOB_IN
registers.description: Resolved pad values; wiring determines reset read

registers.name: T0_CTRL
registers.description: bit 0 enable, bit 1 periodic; writes reset counter and divider

registers.name: T0_COUNT_LO
registers.description: Read low to latch high

registers.name: T0_COUNT_HI
registers.description: Latched high; high-first returns stale latch

registers.name: T0_COMPARE_LO
registers.description: Stage low byte while disabled

registers.name: T0_COMPARE_HI
registers.description: Commit staged low and written high while disabled

registers.name: T1_CTRL
registers.description: bit 0 enable, bit 1 periodic; writes reset counter and divider

registers.name: T1_COUNT_LO
registers.description: Read low to latch high

registers.name: T1_COUNT_HI
registers.description: Latched high; high-first returns stale latch

registers.name: T1_COMPARE_LO
registers.description: Stage low byte while disabled

registers.name: T1_COMPARE_HI
registers.description: Commit staged low and written high while disabled

registers.name: PWM_CTRL
registers.description: bit 0 enable; clear drives low immediately

registers.name: PWM_DUTY
registers.description: Shadow duty, applied at next 256-tick boundary

registers.name: TACH_COUNT_LO
registers.description: Low read latches high

registers.name: TACH_COUNT_HI
registers.description: Latched high

registers.name: XBUS_REG
registers.description: External device register address, low 2 bits

registers.name: XBUS_DATA
registers.description: One external byte-bus transaction

registers.name: ADC_CTRL
registers.description: bit0 enable; bit1 START is write-only strobe

registers.name: ADC_CHANNEL
registers.description: 0 AN0; 1 AN1; writes while busy ignored with ERROR

registers.name: ADC_PRESCALE
registers.description: codes 0..3 = div1,2,4,8; changes require idle

registers.name: ADC_STATUS
registers.description: bit0 BUSY; bit1 READY; bit2 OVERRUN W1C; bit3 ERROR W1C

registers.name: ADC_DATA_LO
registers.description: low read latches high and acknowledges READY

registers.name: ADC_DATA_HI
registers.description: bits0..1 latched high; high-first is stale

registers.name: RST_CAUSE
registers.description: POR/BOR/WDT/DMT/CLOCK/SOFT/EXTERNAL bits 0..6; warm-reset accumulation

registers.name: RST_DETAIL
registers.description: WDT bad key, DMT bad1/bad2/early/late, WDT timeout bits 0..5

registers.name: SW_RESET
registers.description: B6h requests software reset

registers.name: CLK_SOURCE
registers.description: Staged source: 0 FRC, 1 EC, 2 EC with PLL

registers.name: PLL_PREDIV
registers.description: Staged literal divisor 1,2,4,8

registers.name: PLL_MULT
registers.description: Staged literal multiplier 4..16

registers.name: PLL_POSTDIV
registers.description: Staged literal divisor 1,2,4,8

registers.name: PB_DIV
registers.description: Staged literal divisor 1,2,4,8,16,32

registers.name: CLK_STATUS
registers.description: EXT_READY bit0, PLL_LOCK bit1, BUSY bit2, ERROR W1C bit3

registers.name: CLK_ACTIVE
registers.description: Actual source; not the staged request

registers.name: CLK_KEY
registers.description: C3h then 3Ch then COMMIT without intervening access

registers.name: CLK_COMMIT
registers.description: A5h commits staged tuple when unlocked and quiescent

registers.name: PB_ACTIVE
registers.description: Actual peripheral bus divisor

registers.name: WDT_CTRL
registers.description: Fused ON bit0, one-way configuration LOCK bit7

registers.name: WDT_SCALE
registers.description: Literal code k 0..5; timeout 256*2^k independent LFRC ticks

registers.name: WDT_SERVICE
registers.description: A5h then 5Ah; second within fewer than 16 LFRC ticks

registers.name: WDT_STATUS
registers.description: First key armed bit0; configuration ERROR bit7

registers.name: DMT_CTRL
registers.description: Enable bit0; one-way LOCK bit7

registers.name: DMT_LIMIT_LO
registers.description: Staged low byte of maximum count

registers.name: DMT_LIMIT_HI
registers.description: High write commits maximum count

registers.name: DMT_WINDOW_LO
registers.description: Staged low byte of window-open count

registers.name: DMT_WINDOW_HI
registers.description: High write commits window-open count

registers.name: DMT_STATUS
registers.description: OPEN bit0, ENABLED bit1, config ERROR W1C bit7

registers.name: DMT_COUNT_LO
registers.description: Count low; captures high byte

registers.name: DMT_COUNT_HI
registers.description: Captured count high byte

registers.name: DMT_PRECLR
registers.description: 69h in open window; does not refresh counter

registers.name: DMT_CLR
registers.description: 96h after PRECLR within fewer than 16 DMT ticks
